sampling_policy.description: Qualification samples are individual gasleft() measurements from GasProfileMeasureSepolia.t.sol, a real vm.createSelectFork (read-only, no private key, no broadcast) against live Mantle Sepolia state, with the real WHI-501 executor bytecode and real M1 E2E fixture pools (E2EFixturePoolV2, E2EFixturePoolAgniV3) deployed fresh inside the forked EVM, one sample per amountIn in the same fixed 12-point grid used by the mainnet mock-pool suite. This is a genuine fork replay (source=fork_replay), not a synthetic mock — the only two route classes with fixture venues (v2+v3:ticks=0, v3+v2:ticks=0) are exercised; every other route class has no Sepolia fixture and remains explicit Unsupported. WHI-550 (a credentialed live broadcast run against Sepolia) is out of scope for this issue and contributed no samples here.

fee_analysis.notes: Dated 2026-07-27 preliminary read-only Mantle Sepolia sample: 6 points spaced across blocks 41,770,904–41,790,904 (~5,000-block strides) all showed baseFeePerGas=50 gwei and block gas limit=60,000,000, matching mainnet's own observed values. Current stability is not a permanent protocol constant; runtime must still consume live block-header base fee and gas limit at block ingress rather than relying on this snapshot.

replacement_overhead_notes: GasProfileMeasureSepolia.t.sol measures executeArbitrage via gasleft() on the WHI-501 artifact against real fixture pools forked into live Mantle Sepolia state (same call path/checks as the mainnet suite: callback provenance, SafeTransfer, role, deadline, minProfit). Per-route measured ranges (fixture pools, 12-point amount grid): v2+v3:ticks=0: min=113155 max=125955 n=12; v3+v2:ticks=0: min=112351 max=125151 n=12. Only two route classes have Sepolia fixture venues; all others remain explicit Unsupported until additional fixtures land.
